title: Staging MariaDB compatibility for temporary Hostinger gate cleanup statuses

phases.objective: Make the ordered Staging schema replay compatible with MariaDB 11.4 when migration 1039 disables temporary Hostinger gate records using the legal status values defined by their source tables.

e2e_journeys.actor: Staging schema bundle generator and disposable MariaDB 11.4
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: The exact Staging checkout applies the ordered baseline and migrations through migration 1039 in a disposable local MariaDB 11.4 schema.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: platform_runtime_config accepts the disabled runtime-gate status, platform_resource_authority_bindings accepts the revoked cleanup status, the builder regression and ordered pre-use plan pass, and no provider or Production operation is performed.
steps: Load the canonical baseline and ordered migration chain in the isolated schema-bundle builder.
Apply migration 1039 using disabled for platform_runtime_config and revoked for platform_resource_authority_bindings, matching the legal ENUM contracts established by migrations 038 and 950.
Run the builder regression and plan-only audit, then require confirmed disposable replay before producing role bundles.
Keep Production mutation, provider mutation, deployment, credential payload reads, and data export forbidden.
assertions: The platform_runtime_config cleanup writes only the declared active/disabled status contract.
The platform_resource_authority_bindings cleanup writes only the declared active/suspended/revoked/expired status contract.
The migration retains the exact temporary Hostinger binding identity and audit-only expiry semantics.
The Staging builder regression and ordered pre-use plan remain successful before confirmed replay.
Production mutation remains explicitly forbidden and provider access remains forbidden.
